README: PLAT-11.2. The numbers the restore wizard's limits panel and its mapping rails are allowed to state, each owned by Rust and pinned from BOTH languages: ui/tests/restore-subset.spec.js asserts the page renders exactly these, and crates/logweir-api/tests/resources.rs asserts they equal the Rust constants they name. A page that invented a number, or a constant that moved in one language only, fails a test in the other.
